description: This Scala source file defines the DatasetManager object responsible for materializing and updating tables and views in a Spark catalog based on a dataflow graph. It includes methods for creating, updating, and refreshing tables and views, handling schema merging, and managing refresh strategies.

classes.name: DatasetManager
classes.description: Object responsible for managing dataset materialization, including creating/updating tables and views based on a dataflow graph.

classes.name: TableMaterializationException
classes.description: Exception class for capturing errors during table materialization, with attribution to specific tables.

classes.name: TableRefreshType
classes.description: Case class representing the refresh type (full or partial) for a specific table.

methods.name: materializeDatasets
methods.description: Main method to materialize tables and views in the dataflow graph based on refresh strategies.

methods.name: materializeViews
methods.description: Publishes or refreshes all persisted views in the graph.

methods.name: materializeView
methods.description: Creates or replaces a view in the catalog based on a logical plan.

methods.name: materializeTable
methods.description: Creates or updates a table in the catalog, handling schema merging and partitioning.

methods.name: resolveTableProperties
methods.description: Merges user properties with reserved catalog properties for a table.

methods.name: constructFullRefreshSet
methods.description: Determines which tables should be fully refreshed or partially refreshed based on context.
